title: Shien Set for Long-Awaited Hong Kong IPO Debut
summary: From a peak valuation of 100 billion dollars to a targeted debut at a fraction of that figure, ultra-fast fashion giant Shein is preparing for a long-awaited public listing. But as regulatory crackdowns close tax loopholes and squeeze profit margins, the digital retailer is being forced to radically remake its business model. Bloomberg’s Minmin Low reports from Hong Kong. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Oil Rises on Iran Tensions, US Stock Futures Dip: Markets Wrap
summary: Oil jumped in early Asia trading as Middle East tensions accelerated, while the dollar held gains after hawkish comments from Federal Reserve Chair Kevin Warsh fueled bets on a rate hike next month.

title: Latest Oil Market News and Analysis for Aug. 31
summary: Oil surged as fresh fighting flared up in the Strait of Hormuz, highlighting risks to flows from the Middle East after months of conflict.

title: Japan’s NYK CEO on Alternative Routes Amid Iran War
summary: Japanese shipping giant NYK's head Takaya Soga in an exclusive conversation with Bloomberg's Shery Ahn discusses how the company is exploring alternative routes due to the conflict in the Middle East. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Australian Dollar’s Top Forecasters Say Winning Run Likely Over
summary: The Australian dollar’s two-month rally may be nearing a peak, with some of its top forecasters warning that bets on another central bank interest-rate hike have gone too far.
